integrity: The classification is derived directly from the number of external labels 2 and 3 seen by each part and from the positive-support isolation rule. A separate definition-level checker enumerates every four-label assignment on every connected complete multipartite isomorphism type through order eight, tests the graph conditions directly, and matches every weight-enumerator coefficient against the closed formula.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
The minimum-value corollary is not the originality basis because general small-value characterizations may already imply parts of it.
Finite exhaustive verification through order eight is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude differently phrased or non-indexed complete-multipartite enumerators.
title: Weight enumerator for quasi-total double Roman functions on complete multipartite graphs
